Author: Ravindra Maithani
Bench: Ravindra Maithani
High Court Of Uttarakhand At Nainital
 First Bail Application No. 196 of 2023
Smt. Aayat ........Applicant
 Versus
State of Uttarakhand ........Respondent
Present:-
 Mr. Shariq Khurshid, Advocate for the applicant.
 Mr. V.K. Jemini, Deputy Advocate General with Ms. Meena
 Bisht, Brief Holder for the State.
Hon'ble Ravindra Maithani, J. (Oral)
Applicant Smt. Aayat is in judicial custody in Fir No.461 of 2022, dated 24.11.2022, under Sections
363, 366-A, 376-D, 120-B Ipc and Sections 5/6, 16/17 of Protection Of Children From Sexual
Offences Act, 2012, Police Station Jaspur, District Udham Singh Nagar.

entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
She has sought her release
on bail.

2. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
3.
It is argued that the victim has not supported the prosecution case at trial.
4. This fact is admitted by the learned State counsel.
5. The Court wanted to know, is there any electronic, biological or forensic evidence available?
Learned State counsel answered in negative.
6. Having considered, this Court is of the view that it is a case fit for bail and the applicant deserves to be enlarged on bail.
8. Let the applicant be released on bail, on her executing a personal bond and furnishing two reliable sureties, each of the like amount, to the satisfaction of the court concerned.
(Ravindra Maithani, J.) 19.06.2023 Sanjay Smt. Aayat vs State Of Uttarakhand on 19 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/26621593/
